question: site wise average change in shuttle run time from baseline to endline, negative means faster
gold_sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Shuttle Run sec" - b."Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_change FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY b."Location" ORDER BY b."Location"

WITH baseline_shuttle AS (
  SELECT
    "Location",
    AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_baseline
  FROM "sportathon_baseline"
  GROUP BY "Location"
),
endline_shuttle AS (
  SELECT
    "Location",
    AVG("Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_endline
  FROM "sportathon_endline"
  GROUP BY "Location"
)
SELECT
  b."Location",
  (e.avg_shuttle_endline - b.avg_shuttle_baseline) AS avg_change_shuttle_run
FROM baseline_shuttle b
JOIN endline_shuttle e USING ("Location");
